annotation.title_clean: Commission Staff Working Document accompanying the Proposal for a Regulation (EU KIDS ACT - 'EU Keeping Internet Digital Spaces Accountable and Trustworthy')
annotation.title_en: Commission Staff Working Document accompanying the Proposal for a Regulation (EU KIDS ACT - 'EU Keeping Internet Digital Spaces Accountable and Trustworthy')
annotation.summary_en: Commission Staff Working Document supporting the proposed EU KIDS Act on child online safety. It sets out the problem (fragmented national age limits, online risks including AI companions, weak age assurance) and the case for a harmonised EU access delay, safety-by-design and age assurance rules. It also assesses health, fundamental-rights and economic impacts.
key_provisions_or_claims: Harmonised EU-wide delay of access to social media (age 15) with parental-supervised accounts
Mandatory privacy-preserving age assurance using the EU Age Verification Solution
Safety-by-design requirements for digital services and certain AI systems such as AI companions
Child-friendly reporting systems, guardian tools and national strategies
Monitoring and evaluation of the access delay and fundamental-rights impacts
